_comment: Vehicle-to-fitment reference used by MockWheels to resolve a free-text vehicle (e.g. 'my 2020 Subaru WRX') named in SearchFilters.attributes['vehicle'] into a bolt pattern and center bore, so search can filter to wheel variants that actually fit. Fictional platforms are named by their real-world chassis code for recognizability only; no manufacturer data is claimed to be authoritative.
